subject: AWS co-sell listing — partner approval sweep and timeline
messages:
From: Devon Park <devon@cloudbridge.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interest in AWS co-sell + next steps

Hi Priyom and Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the quick call today — CloudBridge is excited to explore an AWS co-sell motion together. Attached is our SOW (high level) and a short deck that outlines the joint go-to-market scenarios we discussed.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood be listed on AWS Marketplace with co-sell enabled?
- Are there any minimum commercial commitments or co-marketing expectations?
- Who is the internal Redwood lead for marketplace intake and legal redlines?

We'll also need a contact at AWS to understand the co-sell classification (ISV Accelerate vs standard listing). I've copied our engagement lead, Devon (me), on the logistics.

Attachments: CloudBridge_SOW_v1.pdf, CB_partner_deck.pdf

Looking forward — can we target an internal readiness check by the end of next week?

Best,
Devon Park
Strategic Partnerships, CloudBridge Consulting
+1 415 555 0198
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Devon Park <devon@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in AWS co-sell + next steps

Devon — thanks for the materials and the call. Welcome — we're keen to explore this.

Quick notes for transparency so the internal team has context:
- Co-sell listing + enablement is viable, but we need procurement + legal sign-off on the commercial terms and the marketplace listing metadata.
- Typical timeline: 2–3 weeks to get a basic listing published (dev/ops review, marketplace form, legal redlines), longer if custom contracts are required.

Vanessa: can you own the intake and coordinate with Laura on contracting? Marcus, can you do a quick ops check for any infra or telemetry requirements we need to expose for the listing process?

Devon: attaching a simple checklist we run internally — fill in any fields you can (pricing bands, support model, ISV classification). Also please share the AWS contact if you have one; otherwise we'll reach out to our AWS channel.

Attachments: AWS_Marketplace_Form.xlsx (please fill), RBW_listing_metadata_draft.md

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: CloudBridge/AWS listing — intake + asks (please action)

Team — looping you in formally. Devon from CloudBridge is the external partner (cc'ed earlier). Key action items before we can commit to co-sell: 

1) Legal/procurement: review attached SOW and confirm whether we need a master services addendum or can proceed on standard T&Cs. Laura, can you estimate turnaround and any redline hotspots?

2) Commercial: decide on list price + discount policy for Marketplace. Vanessa, draft proposed pricing bands and whether we support metered vs subscription.

3) Ops/security: confirm if any telemetry or agent packaging is required for AWS listing (AMI/container requirements, SBOM, supported regions). Marcus — quick feasibility check and a short note on expected infra changes.

4) Listing assets: marketing blurb, logos, 2 screenshots. I'll work with Devon on those; we need final assets by Jan 15 to hit a Jan 26 publish target.

Attachments: CloudBridge_SOW_v1.pdf, AWS_Marketplace_Form.xlsx, RBW_listing_metadata_draft.md

Please reply inline with ETA for your items. If we can't close these by Jan 15, we push publish a week.

Thanks —
Priyom
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Stern <rachel.stern@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: CloudBridge/AWS listing — intake + asks (please action)

Priyom — reviewed the SOW and flagged a few commercial items that will need negotiation: data residency liability language, indemnity cap, and a clause on audit / logs access. I'm proposing we:

- Proceed with an MSA addendum limited to marketplace transactions (fastest route)
- Ask CloudBridge for a carve-out on highly sensitive data; push to a case-by-case basis.

I started a redline and sent the request to Legal Ops to run an accelerated review. I opened a DocuSign envelope for a mutual NDA while we finalize the MSA addendum (link below). Should be able to return a redline in 48 hours unless CloudBridge requests more substantial edits.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/agree/abc123

Cc'ing Rachel from AWS to confirm any marketplace-specific contractual requirements (Rachel, quick question: does AWS require a separate marketplace seller agreement in addition to an MSA for co-sell eligibility?)

Laura Bennett
Dir, Contracts & Procurement, Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Stern <rachel.stern@amazon.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: CloudBridge/AWS listing — intake + asks (please action)

Thanks for looping me in. Short answers and requests: 

- AWS requires a Marketplace Seller Registration and a seller agreement. For co-sell classification we additionally need a completed co-sell eligibility checklist and a qualified AWS account team endorsement.
- I've attached the standard AWS marketplace intake form — please populate fields 1–12 and provide the pricing model (subscription vs metered).
- For ISV Accelerate / co-sell, provide one customer success story and a runbook for deployment (AMI/container + regions).

If you can get the intake form and listing assets to me by Jan 20, I can queue the listing for review the week of Jan 26.

Attachments: AWS_Marketplace_Intake_Form.xlsx

Rachel Stern
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
Amazon Web Services, Inc.
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon@cloudbridge.com>, Rachel Stern <rachel.stern@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: CloudBridge/AWS listing — intake + asks (please action)

Quick internal summary and next steps (for Redwood owners):

- Laura: prioritize the MSA addendum redline and complete DocuSign NDA within 48 hours. Status update due Jan 14 EOD.
- Vanessa: draft pricing bands for subscription + a recommended discount schedule for co-sell partners (due Jan 16).
- Marcus: confirm AMI/container support and any minor infra tasks; provide SBOM guidance and supported regions by Jan 16.
- Devon & CloudBridge: please complete the AWS intake fields we can't fill (commercial contact, one pager for customer story).
- Rachel: thank you — we'll forward the populated intake form and assets by Jan 20 for review.

If everyone meets these dates we can aim to publish the marketplace listing and request co-sell endorsement by Jan 26. I'll track deliverables in HubSpot (deal RBW-7891) and ping if anything slips.

Thanks all —
Priyom
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
